<?php
function peerShift214() { global $late, $owner, $runner; $late = 99; $owner = null; $runner = null; echo 'SHIFT;'; return false; }
class PeerScopeBase214 { public static function capture($saved, $marker) { echo 'BASE;'; return $saved; } public function run() { global $owner, $late, $probe; return $owner->MiSsInG(first: static::capture($late, peerShift214()), later: $probe()); } public function __destruct() { echo 'SCOPE-END;'; } }
class PeerScopeMid214 extends PeerScopeBase214 { public static function capture($saved, $marker) { echo 'PRODUCER:', self::class, ':', static::class, ';'; return $saved; } }
class PeerScopeChild214 extends PeerScopeMid214 {}
class PeerProbe214 { public function __invoke() { global $probe; $probe = null; echo 'PROBE;'; return true; } public function __destruct() { echo 'PROBE-END;'; } }
class PeerBase214 { private static function secret() { return 'PRIVATE'; } public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { global $alias; $alias = 0; echo 'MAGIC;'; return static function () use ($arguments, $name) { echo 'CLOSURE:', self::secret(), ':', self::class, ':', static::class, ';'; return new class($arguments, $name) { public function __construct(public array $saved, public string $name) {} public function __destruct() { echo 'CHILD;'; } }; }; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } }
class PeerDerived214 extends PeerBase214 {}
$owner = new PeerDerived214; $runner = new PeerScopeChild214; $probe = new PeerProbe214; $prefix = 'REQUEST-'; $late = $prefix . 'OLD'; $alias =& $late;
$factory = $runner->run();
echo 'RETURN;'; unset($alias); unset($late); echo 'DETACHED;'; $child = $factory(); unset($factory); echo $child->saved['first'], ':', $child->name, ';'; unset($child); echo 'AFTER;';
